concern: SoftBank's $10-20B bond for its OpenAI stake prices wide of ~8.5%, is downsized, or is pulled
resolve_if: Pricing outcome of the deal
outcome: Priced $11.1B on Sep 24, about 3x covered, at 8.625%, 9.25% and 9.75% dollar coupons, SoftBank's highest ever, with a 65-80bp new-issue concession. Neither downsized nor pulled.

concern: SoftBank's new notes trade below 98 in their first week of secondary trading
resolve_if: A dated secondary print on the new notes
outcome: The notes fell to a 96.75 bid shortly after pricing (Reuters via Japan Times); C4 went back to yellow on Oct 1. The oversubscribed book was bought with price, and secondary trading was the better test.

concern: A hyperscaler trims 2027 capex guidance in Q3 earnings; two or more cutting would be the capex cliff (Stage 4)
resolve_if: Q3 calls of Meta, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon
outcome: All four raised or held: Meta narrowed 2026 guidance up to $135-145B; Microsoft and Alphabet roughly doubled quarterly capex year over year; Amazon held ~$220B and signalled 'meaningfully more' in 2027. B1 stayed green.

concern: Micron's fiscal Q4 (Sep 30) shows softening DRAM or HBM pricing
resolve_if: Micron results and commentary
outcome: Micron pre-guided and then delivered revenue of $49-51B with an 86% gross margin; DRAM spot prices were up about 52% since January. No softening.

concern: TSMC's monthly revenue growth falls under 25% year over year
resolve_if: TSMC September revenue and Q3 call
outcome: TSMC's Q3 revenue grew 50.9% year over year and it raised 2026 capex guidance to $60-64B.

concern: The 10-year Treasury yield breaches 5.25% and holds there (F1 red)
resolve_if: Daily closes from Yahoo or Treasury
outcome: It crossed: F1 read red on Oct 1 and Oct 5-8 with the 10-year near 5.3%, then fell back under 5% by Oct 22 and sat at 4.90% on Nov 4. A brief breach, not a regime.

concern: The MOVE bond-volatility index rises above 130, the disorderly-market threshold
resolve_if: A MOVE close above 130

concern: Oracle's five-year CDS prints above 250bp, the Stage 5 credit trigger
resolve_if: A dated CDS print from a wire or vendor
outcome: Record 288bp on Oct 15 (S&P Global and LSEG data via Reuters), then 295-315bp on Oct 19 per CNBC. C1 turned red on Oct 20 once a wire-attributed print existed.

concern: CoreWeave's bonds trade below 80 cents or a neocloud shows going-concern stress (C5 red)
resolve_if: A dated bond or CDS print, or a filing
outcome: CoreWeave's 9.625% notes due 2032 traded below 80 cents on Oct 14-15 (Bloomberg, citing TRACE, via CNBC) with CDS near 1,200bp; the equity was down 61% from its high by Nov 3.

concern: A down round or cancelled tender at a top-five lab (D2 red, the funding window closing)
resolve_if: Terms of any closed round or tender

concern: OpenAI's ~$30B round closes, and the terms show whether outside capital or suppliers carried it
resolve_if: A confirmed close with investors and valuation, or 90 days open

concern: Anthropic's IPO slips from its October target or reprices
resolve_if: Filing and marketing dates
outcome: Marketing slipped from October to the week of Nov 9 (WSJ, Sep 26). The public S-1 arrived Oct 26 targeting $1.5-2T and a Thanksgiving-week debut. Delayed, not withdrawn, and the filing showed near-breakeven operations.

concern: The Fed hikes again at the Oct 27-28 meeting, pressuring F1 and F5
resolve_if: FOMC statement
outcome: Held at 3.75-4.00% on a 10-2 vote, both dissents favoring a hike. Hawkish hold, no hike.

concern: The Oct 7 10-year and Oct 8 30-year Treasury auctions tail, adding a second F3 trigger
resolve_if: Auction results
outcome: The 10-year cleared strong at 5.300% with a 2.77 bid-to-cover and no tail; the 30-year cleared in line at 5.618% with 2.54 and no tail.

concern: September CPI (Oct 14) comes in hot enough to push the inflation regime to red (F4)
resolve_if: BLS CPI release
outcome: Headline rose to 3.7% from 3.4% with core at 2.6% and gasoline up 34% year over year. Hot, but F4 stayed yellow because headline remained under 4%.

concern: Oracle's Project Jupiter force-majeure dispute with Blue Owl and STACK becomes a confirmed site pause (B2 red)
resolve_if: A company statement or the New Mexico air-permit decision

concern: The Asia memory and chip rout spreads into a US single-day rout severe enough for A6 red
resolve_if: NVDA -10% or SOX -8% in a day, or two -5% days in a week
outcome: SOX fell 6.7% on Oct 22 and 7.2% on Oct 30, two 5%-plus days but in different weeks and never 8%. A6 reached yellow only.

concern: CoreWeave's bonds stay below 80 cents rather than recovering, keeping C5 red on fresh evidence
resolve_if: A dated bond or CDS print, or CoreWeave's Q3 report on Nov 11

concern: Amazon trims 2027 capex in its Oct 29 report, the last of the four hyperscaler guides
resolve_if: Amazon Q3 call
outcome: Held 2026 capex near $220B, signalled 'meaningfully more' for 2027 and guided AWS growth above 40% through 2028.

concern: AMD's Q3 report (Nov 3) misses or guides weak, compounding the chip selloff
resolve_if: AMD results
outcome: Revenue of $13.4B came in above the high end of AMD's own $12.7-13.3B guide with non-GAAP EPS of $2.09; the stock rose 3.65%.

concern: Broad high-yield spreads cross 350bp (C3 yellow), the first sign the single-name stress is spreading
resolve_if: FRED HY OAS or carried proxy

concern: A top-five lab's revenue run-rate growth halves or internal targets are reported missed (D1 yellow)
resolve_if: Dated reporting on run-rates
outcome: OpenAI told investors its September run-rate was nearing $50B, about $20B below the ~$70B figure that had circulated (FT and Reuters, Oct 8). D1 moved to yellow.

concern: The semiconductor index re-crosses a 20% drawdown from its June high (A2 red)
resolve_if: Daily closes
outcome: SOX closed 20.16% below its high on Oct 14 and was 29.4% below by Nov 2.

concern: New governors in Texas, Ohio and Georgia, states with about 39% of planned data-center gigawatts, enact pauses that halt a hyperscaler, Stargate or top-neocloud project (B2 red)
resolve_if: A company-confirmed pause or a signed state measure

concern: Anthropic's IPO prices inside its $1.5-2T range and holds above issue in its first weeks
resolve_if: Pricing and first-week trading

concern: The Stage 5 call, made on two single-name prints, generalizes into broad credit stress
resolve_if: HY OAS above 500bp, a second AI issuer's bonds distressed, or a default; or spreads normalizing and the prints reversing

concern: Oracle gets its planned ~$40B FY27 debt and equity raise done, and on what terms
resolve_if: Deal pricing
outcome: Priced $10B of stock at $116, 20% below the September baseline, plus $10B of notes at 7.00-8.65% coupons, 145-175bp wider than its February deal. Done, but at junk-like coupons and with equity dilution.

concern: The share of fund managers naming an AI bubble as the top tail risk rises above 30% (E1 yellow)
resolve_if: BofA Global Fund Manager Survey
outcome: It fell to 23% in the October survey from 28% in September, behind bond yields and inflation.

concern: Oracle's reported $7bn Tencent AI-chip leasing deal (announced Oct 1) was cancelled, per a Nov 4 T4 aggregator report (Motley Fool/Yahoo) with no T1-T3 confirmation found
resolve_if: A Reuters, Bloomberg, FT, Oracle or Tencent statement confirming or denying the cancellation
outcome: Bloomberg (Nov 4), citing the FT, and Reuters/Investing.com (Nov 4) confirmed Oracle scrapped the $7bn Tencent AI-chip leasing deal under US political pressure; Guangdong officials separately pushed Tencent toward domestic chips. Treated as a geopolitical export-control event, not a credible AI-demand pullback -- B2 stayed yellow rather than moving to red.

concern: TSMC's October monthly revenue release (due ~Nov 10) shows a sharp deceleration from September's +54.6% YoY pace, the first supply-chain confirmation that AI chip demand is cooling (B4 red)
resolve_if: TSMC's October revenue release
outcome: TSMC's October revenue (SEC Form 6-K) grew 59.7% YoY to NT$586.89bn, accelerating from September's 54.6% pace -- the opposite of a deceleration. B4 stays green.

concern: A fresh dated Oracle 5-year CDS print, or a fresh CoreWeave bond/CDS print, appears within 10 trading days (by Nov 20) -- which would restore Stage 5's breadth-and-freshness test after today's reclassification to Stage 1
resolve_if: A dated CDS or bond print from a wire or vendor, or absence of one by the deadline
outcome: A fresh CoreWeave CDS print also appeared: multiple outlets (Benzinga/S&P Global Market Intelligence, Motley Fool, CNBC-sourced aggregators) converged on a record ~1,289bp intraday Nov5, easing to ~1,155-1,195bp by Nov6. Combined with Oracle's already-fresh ~295-315bp print (Nov9), both C1 and C5 now carry dated reds within 10 trading days, satisfying Stage5's breadth-and-freshness test.

concern: SOX sees a second -8%+ single day, or NVDA a -10%+ single day, within two weeks of the Nov 5 rout (by Nov 20) -- testing whether that session was a one-off panic or the start of a sustained break
resolve_if: Daily closes from Yahoo

concern: Anthropic's compute/lease commitments ($895.4bn after the Nov 2 S-1/A, up from $518bn on Oct 26) keep outgrowing revenue in its next disclosure, or it posts a second straight quarterly operating loss, pushing G4 toward red
resolve_if: Anthropic's next filing (10-Q or further S-1 amendment) or IPO prospectus financials

concern: CoreWeave's Nov 11 Q3 report shows going-concern language, a covenant breach, or is accompanied by a fresh bond/CDS print confirming distress, which combined with Oracle's newly fresher CDS print could satisfy Stage 5's two-fresh-red breadth test
resolve_if: CoreWeave's Q3 earnings release and call, or a dated bond/CDS print in the following days

concern: Nvidia's board investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's reported relationship with an alleged Chinese intelligence operative leads to his removal or suspension, a delayed filing, or a sustained NVDA decline beyond 30% from its Oct 6 high within 30 days
resolve_if: A Nvidia company statement or SEC filing on the investigation's outcome, or 30 trading days of price action

concern: The Texas ERCOT/PUCT data-center grid-connection audit (Abbott's Aug3 executive order, newly scored B5 red) gets a legal reversal, a formal end date, or results in a named hyperscaler/Stargate project being granted or denied connection
resolve_if: A court ruling, legislative action, ERCOT/PUCT decision, or a named project's grid-connection outcome

concern: Stage5's credit-event call (triggered today on C1+C5 breadth) holds through CoreWeave's imminent Q3 report and the following two weeks, rather than lapsing back to stale/credit-stress as today's prints age past 10 trading days
resolve_if: CoreWeave's Q3 earnings and call, plus the next dated Oracle and CoreWeave CDS/bond prints through Nov24
